body{background:#0b111c;color:#e9eff8}header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10} nav{gap:20px}
main{padding-top:24px}.compacthero{padding:20px 25px}h1{font-size:clamp(25px,3vw,34px);margin:6px 0}h2{font-size:21px}
.mode-switch{display:inline-flex;gap:3px;border:1px solid #394d66;background:#101b2a;border-radius:10px;padding:4px;vertical-align:middle}
.mode-switch button{border:0;background:transparent;border-radius:8px;color:#aec1d8;font-weight:750;font-size:14px;padding:10px 25px;min-width:145px}
.mode-switch button.active{background:#294456;color:#8ffff0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #6ee7c8}
.mode-note{font-size:12px;color:#a8b8ce;line-height:1.5;margin:7px 0 0}
.controls{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:20px 0 10px}
.controls label{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;color:#b9c8db;font-weight:650;white-space:nowrap}
.controls select{background:#182438;border:1px solid #354861;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;color:#e9eff8;max-width:100%}
#matrix{min-width:870px}.tablewrap{overflow:auto}#matrix th{position:static}
#matrix td:nth-child(1){width:29%}#matrix td:nth-child(2){width:18%}#matrix td:nth-child(3){width:22%}#matrix td:nth-child(4){width:19%}#matrix td:nth-child(5){width:12%}
#matrix tr[data-case]{cursor:pointer}#matrix tr[data-case]:hover td{background:#1b2f45}.thumbstack{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-shrink:0}
.thumbstack img{width:52px;height:52px;object-fit:cover;background:#0a101a;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid #31435d}
.subject{font-weight:800;font-size:13px;line-height:1.4}.subline{color:#a8b8ce;font-size:11px;margin-top:4px}
.flag{display:inline-block;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid #435671;font-size:11px;font-weight:750;white-space:nowrap}
.flag.pass{background:#153d32;border-color:#326b5a;color:#8be0bb}.flag.fail{background:#392932;border-color:#6d4750;color:#ffc5b8}.flag.reported{background:#403521;border-color:#74603a;color:#fbd990}
.wave{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}.wave span{display:block;color:#bfcfe0}
.rmse{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:12px;line-height:1.65}.rmse .good{color:#8be0bb}.rmse .poor{color:#ffb1a6}
.view-link{color:#8cb8ff;font-weight:750;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap}.box-note{margin:12px 0;color:#a8b8ce;font-size:12px}
.empty{padding:35px;text-align:center;color:#b7c7dc}.detailbody h3{margin-top:0}
#detail{width:min(940px,95vw)}#detail .dialogbody{padding:16px 20px 22px}#detailtitle{font-size:17px}
.result-img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;background:#101927;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid #304359;cursor:zoom-in}
.detail-head{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 11px}
.detail-head .stat{color:#aec1d8;font-size:12px}.detail-head .stat b{color:#e9eff8}
.mini-summary{font-size:12px;color:#c3d0e4;margin:12px 0;line-height:1.65}
.mini-summary b{color:#ecf6ff}
.result-missing{display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:145px;border:1px dashed #5d4f43;border-radius:10px;background:#222631;text-align:center;color:#f8d28b;padding:20px}
.result-missing small{display:block;color:#bac8d9;margin-top:8px;max-width:600px}
.source-details{margin:12px 0;border:1px solid #29394f;border-radius:9px;background:#101a29}
.source-details summary{padding:10px 13px;color:#b9cce1;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.source-photos{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;padding:6px 12px 14px}
.source-photos figure{margin:0;min-width:0}.source-photos img{display:block;width:100%;max-height:200px;object-fit:contain;background:#0b111c;border-radius:6px}.source-photos figcaption{font-size:11px;margin-top:5px;text-align:center;color:#b5c8db}
.provenance{font-size:11px;color:#9aafc8;line-height:1.5}.stage-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.stagebtn{border:1px solid #354861;background:#182438;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 11px;color:#dce9f7;text-align:left;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}
.stagebtn:hover{border-color:#6ee7c8}.stagebtn small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#a8b8ce;margin-top:2px}
.sensor-img{width:100%;max-width:870px;border:1px solid #2b3a50;border-radius:9px;display:block;margin:auto}
#overview .eyebrow{color:#6ee7c8}.filtercount{color:#a8b8ce;font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#detail .muted{font-size:12px}.thin-divider{border-top:1px solid #2b3a50;margin:12px 0}
@media(max-width:780px){main{padding:15px 12px 45px}.controls{gap:12px}.mode-switch{width:100%}.mode-switch button{flex:1;min-width:0}.source-photos{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.stage-list{grid-template-columns:1fr}#matrix{min-width:760px}.thumbstack img{width:42px;height:42px}#detail .dialogbody{padding:12px}}

/* Common B17 research navigation – does not change the original result table layout */
.research-switch{display:inline-flex;gap:3px;padding:4px;background:#101d31;border:1px solid #34516f;border-radius:11px;align-items:center}
.research-switch a{display:inline-block;padding:6px 18px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:760;color:#bdcce1;white-space:nowrap}
.research-switch a:hover{color:#f5fcff;text-decoration:none;background:#203653}
.research-switch a.is-current{color:#9df8e0;background:#254359;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #69d9bb}
@media(max-width:680px){.research-switch{order:2;width:100%;justify-content:space-evenly}.research-switch a{flex:1;text-align:center}nav .logo{margin-right:auto}}

.model-history{margin:16px 0 14px;padding:13px 17px;border-left:3px solid #f8d28b;background:#222739;border-radius:8px;color:#d7dfee;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7}
.model-history strong{color:#fce6aa}
.current-research{margin:19px 0 8px;padding:15px 18px;border:1px solid #36546e;background:#11253a;border-radius:11px}
.current-research h2{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 9px}
.current-research p{color:#b9c9dd;font-size:13px;margin:6px 0}
.current-research .mono{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;color:#8ce7d0}
.current-research .tag{font-size:11px;display:inline-block;border:1px solid #5b4b39;color:#f4d59d;border-radius:6px;padding:3px 8px}
.current-research .twocol{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 220px;gap:17px;align-items:center}
.current-research img{width:220px;height:220px;object-fit:contain;border:1px solid #375068;border-radius:9px;background:#090e19}
@media(max-width:700px){.current-research .twocol{grid-template-columns:1fr}.current-research img{width:min(100%,220px);height:auto}}
</style></head><body>
<header><nav><span class="logo">B17 / K=2·3 RESEARCH</span><div class="research-switch" aria-label="연구 모드 전환"><a href="./" class="" >싱글</a><a href="multi.html" class="is-current" aria-current="page">멀티</a><a href="continuous.html" class="" >연속</a></div><a href="#results">이미지별 결과</a><a href="#records">전체 실험 기록</a><a href="#sensor">센서 스펙클</a></nav></header>
<main><section class="hero compacthero" id="overview"><div class="eyebrow">B17 / K=2·3 · 2026.11.17</div><h1>멀티 스펙트럼 복원 결과</h1><p class="muted">Known / Unknown을 선택하고 실험 행을 누르면 해당 조건의 실제 위상 복원 결과만 표시합니다.</p></section>
<div class="model-history"><strong>아래 9개 실험 기록은 과거 조명 조건(물체 외부 진폭 1 등)에서 생성된 역사적 결과입니다.</strong> 2026-11-18부터 사용하는 외부 진폭 0 모델에서 동일한 성능이 재현됐다는 뜻이 아닙니다. 원본 결과는 변경하지 않고 보존합니다.</div><section id="results"><h2>01 · 이미지별 복원 결과</h2><div class="controls"><div><div class="mode-switch" aria-label="파장 조건 선택" role="group"><button id="modeUnknown" type="button" class="active" aria-pressed="true">Unknown · Blind</button><button id="modeKnown" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Known</button></div><p class="mode-note" id="modeNote">관측으로 파장을 추정한 뒤 위상 복원 · 기존 위상 전이 실험은 별도 표시</p></div><label>실험<select id="caseFilter"><option value="all">전체 실험</option></select></label><span class="filtercount" id="count"></span></div>
<div class="tablewrap"><table id="matrix"><thead><tr><th>대상 이미지</th><th>복원 방식 / 판정</th><th>파장 [nm]</th><th>채널별 Phase RMSE</th><th>결과</th></tr></thead><tbody id="resultsBody"></tbody></table></div>
<p class="box-note">합격: 모든 채널의 절대 Circular RMSE ≤ 0.15 rad. <b>보고상 성공</b>과 <b>체크포인트 검증 성공</b>은 구분합니다. Known 단기 검증은 충분히 수렴시킨 최종 결과가 아닙니다.</p></section>
<section class="current-research" id="current-model"><h2>현재 연구 모델 · 물체 바깥 입사광 0</h2><div class="twocol"><div>
<p><span class="tag">진행 중 · 복원 미수렴</span> &nbsp; 2026-11-18 코드 감사 기준</p>
<p>동일 B17 광학계의 <b>5760² 전파 / 2856² 메타표면 / 3000² 센서</b> 유지. 물체 중앙 512²만 조사하며 외부 진폭은 0.</p>
